name: pagame
description: Split group expenses without sign-up: add expenses, see balances and settle up in Pa-ga-me groups.

interface.longDescription:
Pa-ga-me splits shared expenses for trips, flats and dinners, with no accounts or sign-up. Each group is a private link: whoever has it can see the group and add expenses.

With this plugin you can, just by chatting:
- Create a group and get its link to share.
- Add expenses from a description or a photo of a receipt: who paid, how much, and how it is split (equally, by exact amounts or by shares).
- Add expenses in another currency, converted at the day's exchange rate.
- Add recurring expenses such as rent.
- See each person's balance and the fewest payments needed to settle up.
- Record repayments between people.

Everyone in the group sees the changes instantly in the Pa-ga-me app, with push notifications if they enable them. Pa-ga-me needs no account and asks for no personal data: groups are identified only by their link, and groups unused for six months are deleted.
capabilities: Create expense-sharing groups and return their link
Add, edit and delete expenses with flexible splits
Convert foreign-currency expenses at the day's rate
Show balances and the payments needed to settle up
defaultPrompt: Create a Pa-ga-me group for our Lisbon trip with Ana, Luis and me
Add this receipt to my Pa-ga-me group: I paid, split equally
Who owes whom in my Pa-ga-me group?

positive.description: Create an expense-sharing group and return its shareable link.
positive.prompt: Create a Pa-ga-me group called "Lisbon trip" in euros with Ana, Luis and Marta.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the group "Lisbon trip" (EUR) with Ana, Luis and Marta and shows its link (https://pa-ga.me/g/<uuid>), explaining that anyone with the link can open the group. Later cases reuse this group in the same conversation.

positive.description: Add an expense paid by one person and split equally among everyone.
positive.prompt: In my Lisbon trip group, add a 90 euro dinner that Ana paid, split equally among all three.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 90.00 EUR dinner paid by Ana with 30.00 EUR for each person and confirms it; Luis and Marta each owe Ana 30.00 EUR.

positive.description: Add a foreign-currency expense with an uneven split.
positive.prompt: Luis paid 60 US dollars for museum tickets in the Lisbon trip group: 20 dollars for Ana and 40 for himself. Add it.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 60 USD expense paid by Luis, converted to EUR at the day's exchange rate and split 1/3 Ana, 2/3 Luis; reports the converted amount in euros.

positive.description: Show balances and the payments needed to settle up.
positive.prompt: Who owes whom in the Lisbon trip group?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each person's balance (positive means they are owed money) and the suggested payments to settle all debts, e.g. Marta pays Ana 30.00 EUR, consistent with the expenses added.

positive.description: Record a repayment using the pending debt by default.
positive.prompt: Marta has just paid Ana back what she owed her in the Lisbon trip group. Record it.
positive.expected_behavior: Records a repayment from Marta to Ana for the pending amount (30.00 EUR) and confirms Marta no longer owes Ana anything.

negative.description: Sending money: Pa-ga-me records debts but cannot make payments, so no tool should run.
negative.prompt: Send 30 euros to Ana by bank transfer for last night's dinner.

negative.description: A one-off split calculation that needs no shared group or link.
negative.prompt: Quick maths: how much is each of us paying if 4 people split an 86 euro bill plus a 10% tip?

negative.description: Personal budgeting with no shared group involved.
negative.prompt: Help me plan my monthly personal budget: 1,800 euros income, 700 rent, and I want to save 300.

publication.release_notes: First release: create groups, add, edit and delete expenses (equal, exact or share-based splits, foreign currency, recurring), see balances and settle-up suggestions, and record repayments.

es-ES.subtitle: Divide gastos en grupo
es-ES.description:
Pa-ga-me reparte los gastos compartidos de viajes, pisos y cenas, sin cuentas ni registro. Cada grupo es un enlace privado: quien lo tiene puede ver el grupo y apuntar gastos.

Con este plugin puedes, solo conversando:
- Crear un grupo y obtener su enlace para compartirlo.
- Apuntar gastos a partir de una descripción o de la foto de un ticket: quién pagó, cuánto y cómo se reparte (a partes iguales, por importes o por partes).
- Apuntar gastos en otra moneda, convertidos al cambio del día.
- Apuntar gastos periódicos, como el alquiler.
- Ver el saldo de cada persona y los pagos mínimos para quedar en paz.
- Registrar los pagos entre personas.

Todo el grupo ve los cambios al momento en la app de Pa-ga-me, con avisos si los activa. Pa-ga-me no necesita cuenta ni pide datos personales: los grupos se identifican solo por su enlace, y los que no se usan en seis meses se borran.

fr-FR.subtitle: Partagez les dépenses
fr-FR.description:
Pa-ga-me partage les dépenses communes des voyages, colocations et dîners, sans compte ni inscription. Chaque groupe est un lien privé : toute personne qui l’a peut voir le groupe et ajouter des dépenses.

Avec ce plugin, il suffit de discuter pour :
- Créer un groupe et obtenir son lien à partager.
- Ajouter des dépenses à partir d’une description ou de la photo d’un ticket : qui a payé, combien et comment partager (à parts égales, par montants ou par parts).
- Ajouter des dépenses dans une autre devise, converties au taux du jour.
- Ajouter des dépenses récurrentes, comme le loyer.
- Voir le solde de chacun et le minimum de remboursements pour être quittes.
- Enregistrer les remboursements entre personnes.

Tout le groupe voit les changements aussitôt dans l’appli Pa-ga-me, avec des notifications s’il les active. Pa-ga-me fonctionne sans compte et ne demande aucune donnée personnelle : les groupes ne sont identifiés que par leur lien, et ceux inutilisés pendant six mois sont supprimés.
